ChangeLog:
V7.8 Changelog

-> Added Move Hold Time for Use Moves so you can charge a Little more attacks like ki beams, moves that do not charge such as Meteor Crash are not affected by this.
-> Added God Ki Threshold for Use Moves, only applies while you have an active God Ki form.
-> Added Health Threshold for Auto Reform.
-> Added Dash Vanish TP in Targeted Combat section.
-> Added Wait Until Out of Combat setting for Auto Rejoin.
-> Added "Warn" option to Admin Auto Leave dropdown.
-> Improved Auto Transform and added Starting Form, it will use that form first then upgrade when the Health, Ki and Zenkai requirements are met. If you are using a reasonable Health threshold like 30% this allows for 2 zenkais which especially helps in raids and dungeons.
-> Improved Use Moves, will use moves more often and consistently especially while doing actions like m1s.
-> Improved Dash Strength modifier and fixed it letting you dash no matter the state were in.
-> Converted Media section into dropdown in Misc section and added "Hide Server" option.
-> Converted the 4 Shaders buttons into a dropdown and shaders can now be disabled selecting the "--" option.
-> Hide From Players doesn't work in dungeons anymore.
-> Players ESP, Ki ESP and Health Bars now get disabled when the player dies.
-> Moved No Clip to Character page.
-> Fixed Auto Healing Chamber trying to use an already used chamber and getting stuck.
-> Fixed and improved Image Training Mode.
-> Fixed the UI Library translating some features titles and descriptions to your Roblox language.
-> Fixed ESPs staying in the middle of nowhere if the player fused.
-> Other minor fixes and improvements.
